items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I worked with Celestine a while too. I mean, I worked with him a while.

ctx.x: This is where Papa Stamson did with me. When he got family, he forgot I was living.
That's the way it is. That's the way it is. That's right. That's right. That's the way them fellas is. I worked with Celestine a while too. I mean, I worked with him a while.
Are there any other musicians that you can remember now you like that you worked with that were good, like you talked about Piku and helping with those arrangements and helping the rest of the band?
